definition: For each 30%-identity cluster C, max_cross_cluster_id is the maximum qualifying identity between any member of C and any positive sequence outside C. Sequence-divergent iff max_cross_cluster_id < 0.30.
short_sequence_caveat: Pairwise MMseqs2 search uses e-value <=1e-3. Very short peptides may lack significant pairwise hits despite genuine homology. Sub-30% identity bands are therefore descriptive only; family-profile auditing in Step 05 is required.
